title: Command palette
description: A keyboard-first overlay for finding and running actions or navigating: opens with a shortcut and a visible button, shows a search field with a filtered list of commands grouped by type, highlights matched characters, shows shortcuts, and supports nested steps for commands that take an argument.
intent: Give frequent users a fast way to reach any action or page by typing, without hunting through menus.
characteristics: modal dialog containing a combobox and listbox
grouped results (actions, pages, recent) with headings
interaction: Opens with a platform-appropriate shortcut and a visible trigger; arrow keys move the active option, Enter runs it, Escape closes or steps back; focus returns to the trigger on close.
responsive: Full-width sheet on narrow screens anchored to the top so the on-screen keyboard does not hide results; touch users get the visible trigger since shortcuts are unavailable.
accessibility: Combobox with aria-controls and aria-activedescendant on the input; options have role option and group labels; result count announced politely; shortcut must not override browser or screen reader keys.
limitations: Discoverability is low for occasional users; it complements menus, it does not replace them.
Shortcut conflicts vary by keyboard layout and assistive technology.
